label.en: Selling, general and administrative expense ratio

note.zh-TW: 「銷管費用」的名稱說明見該列。
note.en: See the distribution costs and administrative expenses card for the naming.

definition.zh-TW: 銷管費用占營業收入的比例，看做每一份生意要花多少日常開支。數值越低表示營運越精簡。
definition.en: Distribution and administrative expenses as a share of revenue: the everyday cost of winning each unit of business. Lower means leaner operations.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
